vibe.verdict: The right party at Cindy's with real gags all through (Shorty's rules, the feet behind the couch, Ray's lost final episode, Brenda at Shakespeare in Love), though the food is plain party fare and some notes cut to stubs like 'Corn chips.'
missing: Buffy's head still talking after she's decapitated
Cindy's dad and his head stuck in the door
The killer's 'Do you know where I am?' hide-and-seek (only half used)
ideas: Lengthen or rewrite the cut food lines ('Corn chips.', 'Saucy beef.', 'Fudge brownies.') so each reads as a whole dish
Swap 'Cheese and crackers on the coffee table' for something from Cindy's dad's coffee can ('I left you a little something in the coffee can')
changed: Food lines rewritten so the printed part stands alone: Loaded black bean nachos, Parmesan butter popcorn, Beef sloppy joe rolls, Hot fudge brownies
